newsitem.title: MEXICO: Grupo Bafar to list on Mexican stock exchange.
newsitem.headline: Grupo Bafar to list on Mexican stock exchange.

text.p: Mexican meat producer Grupo Bafar will issue shares on the Mexican stock exchange, the brokerage firm Grupo Bursatil Mexicano (GBM) said on Wednesday.
Grupo Bafar will offer 10.5 million B shares at 12 pesos each for a total of 126.18 million pesos, equal to 20 percent of the company's capital.
The offer period is set for Thursday and Friday, the register date on Friday and the liquidation date next Tuesday, GBM said in a news release.
Bafar, founded in 1983, is based in the northern city of Chihuahua. It said it controls 4.5 percent of the Mexican processed meat market.
